functions.name: Reset-ADUserPassword
functions.description: Réinitialise le mot de passe AD d'un utilisateur avec forçage de changement à la prochaine connexion.
functions.source:
function Reset-ADUserPassword {
    param(
        [string]$SamAccountName,
        [string]$NewPassword
    )
    $secPwd = ConvertTo-SecureString $NewPassword -AsPlainText -Force
    Set-ADAccountPassword -Identity $SamAccountName -NewPassword $secPwd -Reset
    Set-ADUser -Identity $SamAccountName -ChangePasswordAtLogon $true
    Unlock-ADAccount -Identity $SamAccountName
    Write-SysLog "MDP réinitialisé pour $SamAccountName" -Level 'INFO'
}

functions.name: Get-StaleADAccounts
functions.description: Identifie les comptes AD inactifs depuis plus de N jours (audit sécurité DSI).
functions.source:
function Get-StaleADAccounts {
    param(
        [int]$InactiveDays = 90,
        [string]$SearchBase = $DefaultOUUsers
    )
    $cutoff = (Get-Date).AddDays(-$InactiveDays)
    Get-ADUser -Filter { LastLogonDate -lt $cutoff -and Enabled -eq $true } `
        -SearchBase $SearchBase `
        -Properties LastLogonDate, EmailAddress, Department | `
        Select-Object Name, SamAccountName, LastLogonDate, Department, EmailAddress
}

functions.name: Set-NTFSPermission
functions.description: Applique ou modifie une règle NTFS sur un dossier pour un compte ou groupe AD.
functions.source:
function Set-NTFSPermission {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Identity,
        [ValidateSet('Read','Modify','FullControl')][string]$Rights,
        [ValidateSet('Allow','Deny')][string]$AccessType = 'Allow'
    )
    $acl  = Get-Acl $Path
    $rule = [System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemAccessRule]::new(
        $Identity, $Rights, 'ContainerInherit,ObjectInherit', 'None', $AccessType)
    $acl.AddAccessRule($rule)
    Set-Acl -Path $Path -AclObject $acl
    Write-SysLog "Permission $Rights ($AccessType) ajoutée sur $Path pour $Identity"
}

functions.name: Join-DomainDSI
functions.description: Intègre un poste au domaine AD DSI, le place dans l'OU appropriée et applique les GPO initiales.
functions.source:
function Join-DomainDSI {
    param([string]$ComputerName, [string]$TargetOU = $DefaultOUComputers, [PSCredential]$Credential)
    Add-Computer -ComputerName $ComputerName -DomainName $DomainFQDN `
        -Credential $Credential -OUPath $TargetOU `
        -Options AccountCreate, JoinWithNewName -Restart -Force
    Write-SysLog "Poste $ComputerName intégré au domaine $DomainFQDN dans $TargetOU"
}

functions.name: Convert-TextToSpeech
functions.description: Convertit un texte en fichier audio WAV/MP3 (TTS local Windows).
functions.source:
function Convert-TextToSpeech {
    param([string]$Text, [string]$OutputPath = "$env:TEMP\speech.wav", [string]$Voice = 'Microsoft Hortense Desktop', [int]$Rate = 0)
    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech
    $speech = New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer
    $speech.SelectVoice($Voice)
    $speech.Rate = $Rate
    $speech.SetOutputToWaveFile($OutputPath)
    $speech.Speak($Text)
    $speech.Dispose()
    Write-SysLog "Text-to-speech generated: $OutputPath"
    return $OutputPath
}
